versions.content: If a single key update operation was finished with success or a key update operation has failed because a function call to CSM or key handler has not returned E_OK or KeyM_KH_Update() has provided the operation type KEYM_KH_ UPDATE_FINISH, the callback function KeyM_CryptoKeyUpdateCallbackNotification() has to be called.
